containers.name: startup-valuation
containers.notes: Next.js release copied from the node's active slot, run as node server.js with uid 1001. NextAuth needs AUTH_SECRET fleet-wide; it stays in /etc/startup-valuation/<slot>.env and is not baked into the image. Lean rebuild 2026-10-27: one COPY --chown layer and no .next/cache, 569 MB -> 404 MB. Rolled out by digest through deploy-digest.yml.

containers.name: startup-valuation-api
containers.notes: pylaunch serving api.index:handler on 8021 with --host 0.0.0.0 (it defaults to loopback). The image recreates /usr/bin/python3.12 for the copied venv's console scripts.

containers.name: startup-valuation-calculate
containers.notes: Same image as the API, different entrypoint (api.calculate:handler) on 8020, declared at priority 23 for /api/calculate.
